shortDescription: Japan’s Mitsui OSK Lines Ltd. plans to sell several older oil tankers to capitalize on surging vessel prices as the Middle East war strains shipping capacity, according to Bloomberg.

title: Mitsui OSK Plans Sale of Older Oil Tankers as Vessel Prices Surge
